name: Temporary Visitor visa (短期滞在)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires showing you'll leave Japan at the end of your visit.
This requires showing sufficient funds for the visit and return journey.

evidence_required.document: Evidence of sufficient funds and intent to leave

outcome.duration_length: up to 90 days (varies by nationality/reciprocal arrangement; some agreements allow up to 6 months split into two 90-day stays)

sources.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan — Short-Term Stay / Temporary Visitor visa

notes: Japan has an extensive visa-exemption arrangement network — many nationalities (including most of the countries already covered in this dataset: UK, most EU states, Australia, US, Canada) can enter visa-free for short stays, only needing the full Temporary Visitor visa process if their nationality lacks such an arrangement. This route encodes the standard visa-required case; the visa-exempt case is not separately modeled as its own route, consistent with how visa-exemption arrangements are handled elsewhere in this dataset. No single-bloc equivalent to the Schengen system exists — each visit to Japan is assessed on Japan's own terms, the same structural point already flagged on Australia's visitor route relative to the European Schengen model.
